resources.string: Records Video, IMU and Camera Meta Data to this location:\n %s
Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) is enabled, you need to compensate for this with the OIS sample data during 3D reconstruction.
Optical Image Stabilization (OIS) is enabled but OIS data is not stored, which means that the saved camera parameters are not valid. Please enable OIS data in settings.
Digital Video Stabilization is enabled, the stored camera parameters will not be correct.
This app requires permission to use the camera.\n\nIt will be useless otherwise.
IMU recording is switched OFF in settings (Sensor streams). This clip will have video and no inertial data, so it cannot be used for visual-inertial work.
GNSS recording is switched OFF in settings (Sensor streams). This clip will carry no position track, no raw measurements and no ephemeris.
GNSS recording is enabled but the location permission has not been granted, so no position track will be recorded. Grant it from Settings -> Sensor streams -> Stream status.
GNSS recording is enabled but the device location switch is off, so no position track will be recorded. Turn location on from Settings -> Sensor streams -> Stream status.
GNSS is running but has no fix yet. Recording now will start the clip without a position track; the track begins whenever the first fix lands.
Distrotion Correction enabled, distortion parameters are invalid.
